header.name: Merge Inventory
header.description:
Merge inventory from a source to a destination.

Either provide a quantity to merge or select "Merge All" to transfer the entire source quantity to the destination, soft-deleting the source inventory in the process.

props.description: Scan the barcode for the inventory you'd like to take from

props.label: Destination Inventory
props.description: Scan the barcode for the inventory you'd like to merge into.

props.label: Merge All
props.description: Whether to take all source inventory and merge it into the destination inventory. This will delete the source inventory record.

props.label: New Destination Qty:

data.__transform:
data.(
  $isNilOrEmpty(currentDestinationQty.value)
  or $isNilOrEmpty(mergeQty)
  or (
    $exists(sourceQtyAvailable.unitId)
    and $exists(currentDestinationQty.unitId)
    and $not(sourceQtyAvailable.unitId = currentDestinationQty.unitId)
  )
  ? null
  : {
    "value": currentDestinationQty.value + mergeQty,
    "unit": $coalesce([mergeQtyUnits, currentDestinationQty.unit, sourceQtyAvailable.unit])
  }
)

props.description: Future quantity of destination inventory after merging

validation.transform:
data.sourceInventory.quantity.value < newValue
 ? "Merge quantity is larger than available source"
